neurons.name: scratch-pad
neurons.definition: the workspace where a draft is written before anything is sent; edits happen here first, and nothing here has gone out yet

neurons.name: draft
neurons.definition: the content currently being written or revised in the scratch pad, not yet sent through the zip loop

neurons.name: edit
neurons.definition: option one: revise the draft in place without sending it; writing or editing a tool-comment counts as this, not as sending

neurons.name: tool-comment
neurons.definition: a note left in the draft while editing, such as a numbered marker for one step of a repeated task; part of editing, and it does not survive into what is finally sent

neurons.name: repeat-counter
neurons.definition: tracking progress across a repeated task, one tool-comment per repetition, e.g. 1, 2, 3, and so on up to however many times the task was asked for

neurons.name: verify
neurons.definition: option two, part one: check the draft is actually correct and complete before it may leave the scratch pad

neurons.name: send-to-zip-loop
neurons.definition: option two, part two: once verified, commit the draft as real output through the zip loop doorway, the only path out of the scratch pad. Tool-comments do not travel with it: they were never part of verify's own connection out of the scratch pad

neurons.name: not-sent
neurons.definition: still inside the scratch pad: everything edited or commented on that has not gone through send-to-zip-loop

"edit"@connections=".draft*0.4+.tool-comment*0.5+.not-sent*0.6+.verify*0.2"
"tool-comment"@connections=".repeat-counter*0.6+.edit*0.3"
"repeat-counter"@connections=".tool-comment*0.5+.edit*0.3"
"verify"@connections=".draft*0.3+.send-to-zip-loop*0.7"
"send-to-zip-loop"@connections=".scratch-pad*0.1"
"not-sent"@connections=".draft*0.4+.edit*0.4"
